title: Nationalist Chinese U-2R in flight
description: Black-and-white photograph of a long-winged U-2R aircraft in flight, viewed from above against a pale background. Captioned "Nationalist Chinese U-2R." Chapter 5 text (page 246) notes Detachment H ceased operational missions in March 1972, the 1973 renegotiation of the TACKLE agreement, and begins the section "Operation SCOPE SHIELD Over North Vietnam."
